skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
skill.summary: Guides AI agents to create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with a clear visual direction.
skill.author: 92Bilal26

security_audit.summary: The three static system reconnaissance findings are false positives in frontend design guidance. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, command execution, network access, or filesystem access was found in the reviewed files.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 7 describes frontend aesthetic goals and working code quality. It does not instruct the agent to inspect the host system, collect environment data, or enumerate files.
Line 30 gives typography guidance for interface design. It does not request system reconnaissance, credential access, filesystem inspection, or network activity.
Line 34 recommends visual background details such as textures and shadows. This is design advice, not a request to gather system or user data.

content.value_statement: Generic interfaces make products feel unfinished and hard to remember. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to build polished frontend designs with stronger visual direction.
actual_capabilities: Guides context analysis before frontend implementation.
Encourages a clear aesthetic direction for each interface.
Provides typography, color, motion, layout, and background guidance.
Supports HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and similar frontend work.
Pushes generated interfaces toward distinctive production-grade visual polish.
limitations: It provides design guidance, not a reusable component library.
It does not include automated accessibility or performance testing.
It depends on the agent to implement code in the target project stack.
It may require user constraints to avoid overly bold visual choices.

use_cases.title: Build a Product Dashboard
use_cases.description: Create a polished dashboard interface with memorable layout, refined spacing, and useful visual hierarchy.

use_cases.title: Design a Marketing Page
use_cases.description: Turn a product concept into a distinctive page with strong typography, color, motion, and atmosphere.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing UI
use_cases.description: Refine a generic component or page into a more cohesive and visually intentional experience.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Component
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused UI element.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design and implement a pricing card component for a modern SaaS product. Include responsive styling and clear visual hierarchy.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a complete screen.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a landing page for a design analytics tool. Choose a bold visual direction and implement the full responsive page.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign a Generic Interface
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request to improve existing UI quality.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to redesign my current settings page. Keep the same functions, but improve typography, spacing, color, and interaction polish.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Advanced App Surface
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with product context and constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to build a project management workspace for creative teams. Include dense task data, distinctive navigation, motion, and accessible responsive states.

output_examples.input: Create a homepage for a boutique architecture studio.
output_examples.output: A responsive homepage with editorial typography, asymmetric image placement, restrained motion, project highlights, and a refined contact section.

output: A stronger layout with clearer data hierarchy.
A more intentional color system and typography pairing.
Interactive states that make key metrics easier to scan.

output_examples.output: A compact event experience with bold time and location treatment, atmospheric visuals, clear calls to action, and polished responsive behavior.

best_practices: Provide the product purpose, audience, stack, and brand constraints before asking for implementation.
Ask for responsive states, accessibility expectations, and interaction details in the same request.
Review generated visuals against the real product context before accepting bold design choices.
anti_patterns: Do not request a generic modern page without product context or audience details.
Do not use this skill as a substitute for security, accessibility, or performance review.
Do not force every project into maximalist visuals when the product needs restraint.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create frontend components, pages, and applications with stronger visual direction and production-grade polish.

faq.question: Does it write working code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the agent to implement working frontend code in common web technologies.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it only for React projects?
faq.answer: No. The guidance mentions HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vue, and similar frontend implementations.

faq.question: Does it include assets or a design system?
faq.answer: No. It provides design and implementation guidance, but it does not ship a component library or asset pack.

faq.question: Is security remediation required?
faq.answer: No evidence of malicious behavior was found. The static findings were design-prose false positives.
